verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a first-party docs page titled "API Access & Keys", and release notes reference a server /api/ping endpoint, so the product itself exposes a documented API. The evidence is only a page title, though, with no detail on endpoints, coverage of product functions, or auth flow. Probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec on the docs domain. Missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation showing the API can drive core features (workspaces, chats, documents, agents), a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: fix: point k8s probes at the server's /api/ping
